feedback: Your essay identifies the key issues regarding cellphone use in schools, such as privacy, equity, and distraction. To improve, focus on developing your ideas into cohesive paragraphs. Currently, your sentences feel like a list of separate points; try using linking words (like 'furthermore', 'consequently', or 'however') to connect your thoughts logically. Additionally, try to expand on your evidence. Instead of just stating that a phone can be a dictionary, explain how this specifically enhances the learning process compared to traditional methods. Finally, ensure your introduction clearly outlines your stance so the reader knows exactly what you are arguing from the start. With more focus on structure and depth, your writing will become much more persuasive.
